tools.name: postToX
tools.description: Post a tweet to X/Twitter using the shared linda-profile. Requires Bo to have logged in once. Text <=280 chars. Optional image path.

dryRun.description: Skip the real post — verify argv only.

tools.name: postToTikTok
tools.description: Upload a video + caption to TikTok Studio via the logged-in profile. Uses patchright for stealth.

videoPath.description: Absolute local path to video/image file.

tools.name: generateImage
tools.description: Generate a 1024x1024 image via free-first multi-provider chain. Default chain: NVIDIA nvapi (FLUX.1-schnell) → Gemini 2.5 Flash Image → local ComfyUI. Returns the output file path. Fireworks is removed (paid/suspended).

outPath.description: Optional absolute output path. Defaults to C:/Users/bobel/social/out/<timestamp>.png.

provider.description: Which provider to use. 'auto' (default) tries nvidia → gemini → local and returns on first success. Pin to a specific provider for debugging or isolation.

force.description: Overwrite outPath if it already exists.

tools.name: shellExec
tools.description: Execute a shell command. Uses cmd.exe on Windows, /bin/sh elsewhere. Captures stdout+stderr (truncated to 4KB each).

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to process cwd.

tools.name: browserLogin
tools.description: Headless login automation via Playwright. Fills username+password selectors, optionally clicks a submit, persists cookies in linda-profile. If twoFactorHook=true and a 2FA page appears, Telegram-pings Bo and polls for up to 3 minutes.

submitSelector.description: Optional. If omitted, presses Enter after filling password.

saveProfile.description: Always true — cookies persist in linda-profile.

twoFactorHook.description: If true, pause and Telegram-ping on 2FA pages.

tools.name: createAccount
tools.description: Create a new account on X, TikTok, or a generic form. Credentials are appended to C:/Users/bobel/.secrets/jarvis-accounts.env. CAPTCHAs are NOT auto-solved — Jarvis pages Bo and stops.

tools.name: speak
tools.description: Text-to-speech via local Piper (free, offline). Generates a .wav in a Paul-Bettany-style British male JARVIS voice (en_GB-alan-medium). Optionally converts to ogg/opus via ffmpeg and sends to Telegram as a voice note. Never calls paid TTS APIs.

outPath.description: Optional absolute output .wav path. Defaults to C:/Users/bobel/tmp/jarvis-speech/<timestamp>.wav.

voice.description: Voice alias. 'alan' = local Piper (free, offline). 'adam' = ElevenLabs (paid, requires ELEVENLABS_API_KEY env var). JARVIS_VOICE_ENGINE=elevenlabs forces ElevenLabs for any voice.

sendToTelegram.description: If true, convert wav -> ogg via ffmpeg and POST to Telegram sendVoice. Falls back to sendAudio (wav) if ffmpeg fails.

telegramChatId.description: Optional override. Defaults to Bo's chat id 7240677590.

tools.name: getCalendar
tools.description: Fetch upcoming calendar events from Bo's Google Calendar. Returns the next 7 days by default.

days.description: How many days ahead to fetch. Default 7.

tools.name: listen
tools.description: Speech-to-text via local faster-whisper (free, offline, CPU/CTranslate2). Transcribes a local audio file (wav/ogg/mp3/m4a — anything ffmpeg/libsndfile reads). Default model: base.en (~140MB). Override with WHISPER_MODEL env or `model` arg (small.en, medium.en, large-v3). Never calls paid STT APIs.

audioPath.description: Absolute local path to the audio file.

language.description: ISO language hint (e.g., 'en'). Auto-detected if omitted.

model.description: Override default model (base.en, small.en, medium.en, large-v3). Auto-downloaded on first use.

tools.name: createFolder
tools.description: Create a directory (and any parent directories) on the local filesystem.

tools.name: writeDoc
tools.description: Write or append to a text file on the local filesystem. Creates parent directories if needed.

append.description: If true, append instead of overwrite. Default false.

tools.name: appendNote
tools.description: Append text to an existing file in the COG vault without overwriting. Creates the file if it doesn't exist. Prefer this over writeDoc with append=true for additive writes like logs, queues, and running notes.

tools.name: createCalendarEvent
tools.description: Create a new event on Bo's Google Calendar.

tools.name: updateCalendarEvent
tools.description: Update an existing event on Bo's Google Calendar by event ID.

tools.name: deleteCalendarEvent
tools.description: Delete an event from Bo's Google Calendar by event ID.

tools.name: syncCalendarToVault
tools.description: Sync today's calendar events to the Obsidian COG vault daily note. Call this after fetching calendar if Bo wants events saved to Obsidian.

days.description: How many days to sync. Default 1 (today only).

tools.name: calculateEarnings
tools.description: Calculate today's estimated earnings from Spotless Solutions calendar events using the known pricing structure. Returns revenue total and breakdown.

date.description: Date to calculate for in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

tools.name: learnTopic
tools.description: Research and permanently store knowledge about any topic in the COG vault. Use when Bo says 'go learn about X' or 'research X for me'. Stores facts as instincts that will surface in future conversations automatically.

count.description: Target number of facts to learn. Default 20.

depth.description: surface=quick overview, deep=thorough research. Default deep.

tools.name: searchKnowledge
tools.description: Search stored COG knowledge for facts relevant to a topic or question. Use proactively when Bo asks about something Jarvis may have learned previously.

tools.name: createJarvisTask
tools.description: Create a new task. Use when Bo asks Jarvis to add, create, or schedule a task.

tools.name: listJarvisTasks
tools.description: List Bo's active tasks. Defaults to open + in_progress when no status is given.

status.description: Filter by status. Omit for open+in_progress.

tools.name: completeJarvisTask
tools.description: Mark a task as done.

proof.description: Optional URL, path, or quote confirming completion.

tools.name: delegateToClaudeCode
tools.description: Spawn a real Claude Code CLI session to handle complex coding tasks. Use when the task requires multi-file edits, refactors, or builds beyond simple tool calls. Returns the changes made.

task.description: The full instruction to pass to Claude Code.

budgetUsd.description: API spend cap in USD. Default 0.50.

tools.name: searchWeb
tools.description: Search the live web via Tavily. Use for current events, real-time info, research, prices, or anything outside training data. Returns a direct answer plus source snippets.

tools.name: fetchUrl
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return its text content. Use to read articles, docs, or any webpage Bo links.

tools.name: githubOps
tools.description: Interact with GitHub: list PRs, list issues, create issues, comment on issues, list repos, get commits. Default repo: bobellconstulting-creator/neuradexai-site.

tools.name: sendTelegramMessage
tools.description: Send a Telegram message to Bo or the fleet. Defaults to Bo's chat. Use for notifications, alerts, or pinging team agents.

chatId.description: Target chat ID. Defaults to Bo's chat ID.

bot.description: Which bot token to use. Default 'jarvis'.

tools.name: systemInfo
tools.description: Get the server's current system status: CPU, memory, uptime, hostname. Use when Bo asks about server health or resource usage.

detail.description: 'summary' for key metrics, 'full' for all OS data.

tools.name: vercelDeploy
tools.description: Trigger a Vercel production deployment for neuradexai. Use when Bo says 'deploy' or 'push to production'.

projectId.description: Vercel project ID. Defaults to neuradexai.

tools.name: readDoc
tools.description: Read a file from the COG Obsidian vault. Use to check the research queue, interests list, or any vault note. Path is relative to COG root (e.g. 'RESEARCH-QUEUE.md', '00-inbox/MY-INTERESTS.md').

path.description: File path relative to COG vault root.

tools.name: queueResearch
tools.description: Add a topic to the research queue (COG/RESEARCH-QUEUE.md). Jarvis drains the queue automatically each night. Use when Bo says 'queue up', 'add to research list', 'look into later', or when Jarvis wants to research something found mid-conversation.

priority.description: High priority items get researched first. Default normal.

notes.description: Optional context or angle for the research.

tools.name: sendEmail
tools.description: Send an email via Gmail SMTP (nodemailer). Use when Bo asks to email someone or send a notification. Requires SMTP_USER and SMTP_PASS env vars. dryRun=true logs the message without sending.

dryRun.description: If true, log the email but do not send it.

tools.name: readEmail
tools.description: Read recent emails from Gmail inbox via IMAP. Returns sender, subject, and snippet for each message. Use when Bo asks to check email, read inbox, or when a cron job monitors for new mail. Requires SMTP_USER and SMTP_PASS env vars with IMAP enabled.

folder.description: Mailbox folder to read. Default INBOX.

sinceMinutes.description: Only messages received in the last N minutes. Default 30.

tools.name: createEtsyListing
tools.description: Create a DRAFT product listing via the Printify API (free). Creates a draft only — not published to Etsy until Bo reviews and publishes from Printify dashboard. Requires PRINTIFY_API_KEY and PRINTIFY_SHOP_ID env vars.

productType.description: Product type. Maps to Printify blueprint: tshirt=5, mug=77, poster=446, hoodie=92.

imageUrl.description: URL of print-ready image (optional). Can be added in Printify later.

dryRun.description: If true, return the payload without posting to Printify.

tools.name: findProspects
tools.description: Research potential AI consulting prospects via web search and save structured findings to COG/04-projects/neuradex-consulting/prospects.md. Use when Bo says 'find me leads', 'research prospects', or 'who should I pitch'.

niche.description: Target niche/market, e.g. 'small business Kansas', 'real estate agencies midwest'. Defaults to 'small business AI automation midwest'.

count.description: Number of prospects to find. Default 5.

tools.name: storeCredential
tools.description: Store or update a credential in the local vault (~/.secrets/jarvis-vault.json). Upserts by service slug. Use when Bo creates a new account or rotates a password. Passwords are never logged.

service.description: Service name, e.g. 'digitalocean'. Stored as lowercase slug.

username.description: Username or email for this service.

password.description: Password. Never logged or sent to Telegram.

tools.name: getCredential
tools.description: Retrieve a stored credential from the vault by service name. Returns username, password, url, notes, updatedAt. For tool use only — never surface passwords in Telegram messages.

service.description: Service name to look up, e.g. 'digitalocean'.

tools.name: listCredentials
tools.description: List all services in the credential vault. Returns service names, usernames, urls, and timestamps. Passwords are NOT included.

tools.name: localBridgeExec
tools.description: Execute a shell command on Bo's local machine via the local bridge server. Use when shellExec is BLOCKED on Vercel. Requires LOCAL_BRIDGE_URL and LOCAL_BRIDGE_SECRET env vars to be set.

cmd.description: Shell command to run on Bo's local machine.

tools.name: runClaudeCode
tools.description: Spawn Claude Code CLI to complete a coding task, build a feature, fix a bug, or run an analysis. Returns the full output. Use when Bo asks to build something, fix code, or when a task requires writing/running code. Requires claude CLI on PATH.

prompt.description: The task/question to send to Claude Code.

tools.name: telegramPollIdeas
tools.description: Poll Telegram Bot API for new idea/capture/note messages from Bo (chat ID 7240677590). Strips the prefix and returns clean text. Automatically advances an offset file so messages are never reprocessed. Used by the jarvis-idea-capture cron (every 2 min). Requires TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN env var.

maxMessages.description: Max idea messages to return in one poll. Default 10.
